About Me

I don't just build things — I craft full products.

I'm Fedi Mhadhbi, a Business Information Systems student at ESEN (École Supérieure de l'Économie Numérique) in Tunisia, obsessed with turning complex problems into elegant, deployable digital products. While others are learning syntax, I'm shipping LMS platforms with AI tutors, productivity PWAs, and full Arabic educational systems.

My full-stack approach runs from Nginx server configuration on Ubuntu 24 down to pixel-perfect RTL Arabic UIs — custom MVC PHP backends, MariaDB optimization, Firebase real-time sync, and integrations with OpenAI, Gemini, and Groq APIs.

I don't believe in mobile-app-as-a-shortcut. I build installable PWAs and mobile-first responsive web apps — the right tool that reaches every device without the overhead.

🤖 AI Products🎨 UI/UX Design ⚙️ n8n Automation📱 PWA Dev 🇸🇦 Arabic RTL UI🏗️ Custom MVC PHP 🚀 SaaS Mindset🌍 Tourism Tech🗺️ Civic Tech🔌 Nour Project

Real projects that ship.

Every project started with a real problem. Each one taught me something the docs never could — including Nour, now used by ~900 Tunisians daily.

LIVE ~900 Users
PWAFirebaseMap
🔌💧 Nour — Live Outage Map
A live crowdsourced map tracking power and water outages across Tunisia in real time — built solo, used by nearly 900 people. One tap to report, instantly visible to everyone nearby.
Problem
No real-time outage visibility for Tunisians
Impact
~900 active users, fully live & free
Vanilla JSFirebaseOpenStreetMap Leaflet.jsPWARTL Arabic
🌐 Live Demo GitHub
Core Features: 📍 Live power & water outage map — community-reported, real-time Firebase sync
🔎 Neighborhood search by name (no map hunting)
📊 7-day outage history per area — trends, not just current state
🆘 Medical SOS alerts with private messaging during outages
📲 Installable PWA on Android & iPhone — no App Store needed
🌍 Fully trilingual: English, French, Arabic with proper RTL layout

Architecture: Vanilla JS SPA + Firebase Realtime Database for live geo-tagged reports + Leaflet.js on OpenStreetMap tiles. Anonymous usage — no account required. Service Worker for offline/installable PWA. Geolocation API for automatic area detection.
🔒 Private
Full StackLMSArabic RTL
🏫 Tunisian Educational Platform
Full Arabic LMS for Grades 1–9 with 4 roles, real-time dashboards, AI-ready architecture, and RTL-first UI built on PHP 8.3 custom MVC.
Problem
No Arabic-first LMS for Tunisian schools
Impact
4 roles, 11 MariaDB tables, full RBAC
PHP 8.3Custom MVCMariaDB NginxUbuntu 24RTL CSS
🔒 Request Access Case Study
Architecture: Custom PHP 8.3 MVC framework built from scratch — Router, Controller, Model layers with PSR-4 autoloading. Nginx + PHP-FPM on Ubuntu 24 via VMware. VS Code Remote SSH workflow.

Database: MariaDB 11 with 11 normalized tables — users, roles, lessons, quizzes, homework, grades, badges, notifications, sessions, parent-child links, progress tracking.

Features: Arabic RTL responsive UI, role-based dashboards (student/parent/teacher/admin), live search autocomplete, achievement badge system, parent-child analytics, real-time notifications, Git versioning.
